blocks.raw: The configuration of property variables isn't unique to AMD, and it's not required to set up your AMD property. See [Variable support](https://techdocs.akamai.com/property-mgr/docs/var-ov) in the Property Manager user documentation for more details. You can also discuss possible integration with your account team.
